variables.name: FS_INVOKE_CHILD_CANCEL_ON_TIMEOUT
variables.notes: Whether a finite child workflow invocation that times out is cancelled. Applies only to the finite invocation path of a child called from a parallel lane (and that child's descendants); a serial invoke_workflow step waits durably (awaiting_child) without a worker and ignores it.

variables.name: FS_INVOKE_CHILD_POLL_SECONDS
variables.notes: Polling interval of the finite child workflow wait. Applies only to the finite invocation path of a child called from a parallel lane (and that child's descendants); a serial invoke_workflow step waits durably (awaiting_child) without a worker and ignores it.

variables.name: FS_INVOKE_CHILD_TIMEOUT_CAP_SECONDS
variables.notes: Hard cap for the finite child workflow wait timeout. Applies only to the finite invocation path of a child called from a parallel lane (and that child's descendants); a serial invoke_workflow step waits durably (awaiting_child) without a worker and ignores it.

variables.name: FS_INVOKE_CHILD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.notes: Timeout of the finite child workflow wait. Applies only to the finite invocation path of a child called from a parallel lane (and that child's descendants); a serial invoke_workflow step waits durably (awaiting_child) without a worker and ignores it. A durable serial wait has no wall-clock limit: a child may wait a day on a Wait step or indefinitely on an Approval.

variables.name: FS_INVOKE_INLINE_EXECUTION
variables.notes: Run a finite (lane) child workflow inline under the current worker and project lease (default 1). With 0 the finite lane path needs an independent worker for the child; the single-worker guarantee holds only with the default. A serial invoke_workflow step never runs its child inline: the parent parks (awaiting_child) and releases its worker.

variables.name: FS_INVOKE_WORKFLOW_MAX_DEPTH
variables.notes: Maximum nested invoke_workflow depth in one chain; a deeper chain fails closed.
